snippet.title: Seleri's Lament FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Seleri's Lament By Raingarita Ending A: Good morning, Seleri

In the depths of the forest of Lovellia there is a girl, who calls herself a "witch", with a mission to deliver a mysterious letter to a detective "friend", but... it looks like it won't be as easy as she may have thought at first, one hardship after another will show up, thus she will have put forth her utmost effort to deliver the letter and complete her mission.

Seleri's Lament: https://raingarita.itch.io/sl
Developer: Raingarita
Genres: Adventure, Visual Novel
Platforms: Microsoft Windows
